Source: https://fuel.gazebosim.org/1.0/OpenRobotics/models/Small%20Dry%20Bag — OpenRobotics, CC-BY-4.0.

USD, MuJoCo and GLB retain original metric scale and available textures. Collision: source compound cylinders/boxes. Mass and friction are estimated.
